newsitem.title: TURKEY: Rocket hits Istanbul police HQ, no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Rocket hits Istanbul police HQ, no casualties.

text.p: Two assailants fired an anti-tank rocket at the main police headquarters in Istanbul, Turkey's biggest city, on Monday but there were no reports of deaths or injuries, officials said.
They said a man and a woman fired the rocket from the garden of a hospital across the road from the police station, in the centre of the city.
"Police forces have cordoned off the area. They are searching every inch to try to catch those responsible," Istanbul governor Ridvan Yenisen told Reuters.
The pair fled after leaving behind the rocket launcher, as well as gloves used to avoid leaving fingerprints.
The rocket broke windows at the narcotics department on the fifth floor and blackened the building's outside wall, witnesses said.
No group immediately claimed responsbility for the attack. Leftist urban guerrillas, Islamist militants and Kurdish rebels have all carried out attacks in Istanbul in the past.
